Name: Addgene
Description: Addgene is a nonprofit plasmid repository founded in 2004 by Melina Fan, Kenneth Fan, and Benjie Chen. Based in Watertown, Massachusetts, Addgene facilitates the sharing of plasmids—circular DNA molecules commonly used in genetic research—among scientists worldwide. Researchers deposit their plasmids into Addgene's repository, where they undergo quality control, including sequencing, to ensure accuracy. These plasmids are then cataloged in a comprehensive, searchable online database, making them accessible to other researchers for experimental use. As of 2024, Addgene's collection has expanded to over 147,000 plasmids, contributed by more than 3,000 laboratories. The repository includes plasmids for various applications, such as genome engineering (including CRISPR systems), gene expression, shRNA knockdown, and viral-mediated gene delivery.
